title: Application Performance Dashboard
description: Per-run load-test metrics. Panels scope to the time picker ∩ the run (the whole test by default; the UI 'Open in Grafana' link sets the picker to the run's exact range). Throughput/Samples/Avg/Error%/status match JMeter; percentiles are a throughput-weighted approximation of per-second values. Labels are shown exactly as JMeter emits them.

list.name: runId
list.label: Run
list.rawQuery: SELECT "runId" FROM (SELECT "runId", MAX("windowSecond") AS lastSec FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond") GROUP BY "runId") sub ORDER BY lastSec DESC LIMIT 100

list.name: label
list.label: Label
list.rawQuery: SELECT DISTINCT "label" FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond") ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "workerId") AS workers FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond")

SELECT SUM("throughput")::FLOAT / 120.0 AS throughput FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND "windowSecond" >= COALESCE((SELECT MAX("windowSecond") - 120 FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}')), 0)

SELECT (SUM("errorCount")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0)) AS error_rate FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond")

SELECT SUM("sumElapsedMs")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS avg_ms FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond")

SELECT SUM("p90Ms"::BIGINT * "throughput")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS p90 FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond")

SELECT SUM("p95Ms"::BIGINT * "throughput")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS p95 FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond")

SELECT SUM("p99Ms"::BIGINT * "throughput")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS p99 FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond")

SELECT to_timestamp("windowSecond") AS "time", SUM("throughput") AS "Throughput" FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond") GROUP BY "windowSecond" ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Response time (Avg / P90 / P95 / P99)
panels.description: Percentiles are approximate; line marks the 300 ms SLA.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp("windowSecond") AS "time", SUM("sumElapsedMs")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS "Avg", SUM("p90Ms"::BIGINT * "throughput")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS "P90", SUM("p95Ms"::BIGINT * "throughput")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS "P95", SUM("p99Ms"::BIGINT * "throughput")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS "P99" FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond") GROUP BY "windowSecond" ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp("windowSecond") AS "time", SUM("errorCount")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS "Error rate" FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond") GROUP BY "windowSecond" ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp("windowSecond") AS "time", j.key AS metric, SUM((j.value)::bigint) AS "count" FROM metrics."workerMetric", LATERAL jsonb_each_text("statusCodes") AS j WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond") GROUP BY "windowSecond", j.key ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp("windowSecond") AS "time", "label" AS metric, SUM("throughput") AS rps FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND ('${label:raw}' = '__all__' OR "label" = '${label:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond") GROUP BY "windowSecond", "label" ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp("windowSecond") AS "time", "label" AS metric, SUM("sumElapsedMs")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS v FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND ('${label:raw}' = '__all__' OR "label" = '${label:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond") GROUP BY "windowSecond", "label" ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Aggregate Report
panels.description: Per-label summary over the selected window, ordered by Samples (desc). Paginated. Percentiles are approximate.

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT "label" AS lbl, "throughput", "errorCount", "sumElapsedMs", "p90Ms", "p95Ms", "p99Ms", "windowSecond", "statusCodes" FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond")), num AS (SELECT lbl, SUM("throughput") AS samples, SUM("sumElapsedMs")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS avg_ms, SUM("p90Ms"::BIGINT * "throughput")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS p90, SUM("p95Ms"::BIGINT * "throughput")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS p95, SUM("p99Ms"::BIGINT * "throughput")::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS p99, 100.0 * SUM("errorCount") / NULLIF(SUM("throughput"), 0) AS err_pct, SUM("throughput")::FLOAT / NULLIF(MAX("windowSecond") - MIN("windowSecond") + 1, 0) AS tput FROM base GROUP BY lbl), codes AS (SELECT lbl, SUM(CASE WHEN j.key ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND (j.key)::int BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN (j.value)::bigint ELSE 0 END) AS c2xx, SUM(CASE WHEN j.key ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND (j.key)::int BETWEEN 300 AND 399 THEN (j.value)::bigint ELSE 0 END) AS c3xx, SUM(CASE WHEN j.key ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND (j.key)::int BETWEEN 400 AND 499 THEN (j.value)::bigint ELSE 0 END) AS c4xx, SUM(CASE WHEN j.key ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND (j.key)::int BETWEEN 500 AND 599 THEN (j.value)::bigint ELSE 0 END) AS c5xx FROM base, LATERAL jsonb_each_text(base."statusCodes") AS j GROUP BY lbl) SELECT num.lbl AS "Label", num.samples AS "Samples", num.avg_ms AS "Avg", num.p90 AS "P90", num.p95 AS "P95", num.p99 AS "P99", num.err_pct AS "Error%", num.tput AS "Throughput", COALESCE(codes.c2xx, 0) AS "2xx", COALESCE(codes.c3xx, 0) AS "3xx", COALESCE(codes.c4xx, 0) AS "4xx", COALESCE(codes.c5xx, 0) AS "5xx" FROM num LEFT JOIN codes ON codes.lbl = num.lbl ORDER BY num.samples DESC

panels.title: Active threads per worker
panels.description: Per-worker thread count — spot uneven load.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp("windowSecond") AS "time", "workerId" AS metric, MAX("activeThreads") AS threads FROM metrics."workerMetric" WHERE ('${runId:raw}' = '__all__' OR "runId" = '${runId:raw}') AND $__unixEpochFilter("windowSecond") GROUP BY "windowSecond", "workerId" ORDER BY 1
